description: Detektion av SARS-CoV-2 och andra humana enteriska virus i avloppsvatten från Göteborg is a dataset listed in Sweden's data portal, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Göteborgs universitet. The dataset is part of a research study lead by adjunct professor Heléne Norder and colleagues at Gothenburg University and the Clinical Microbiology Laboratory at Sahlgrenska University Hospital and at the Gryaab wastewater treatment plant in Gothenburg. Coverage: Göteborgs universitet. The portal shows the English title as "Detection of SARS-CoV-2 and other human enteric viruses in wastewater from Gothenburg" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Göteborgs universitet. Its keywords include Public health not elsewhere classified, Environmental epidemiology. The listing shows 2023-12-14 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support water network and flood-defence studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-oppnadata.
